customer: hi, im moving for a new job and want to sell my full size suv before i go but my ex wife is still on the titel. do i really need her to sign?? we're divorced and i dont realy want to track her down
agent: Since your ex-spouse is still listed on the title, they would normally need to sign too, the same as any co-owner. The exception is if your divorce decree awards the SUV to you: in that case, bring a certified copy of the decree and your ex's signature isn't needed. If your name changed in the divorce, please also see our article "The name on the title doesn't match my ID."
